description: Accessibility identifiers every ExampleApp implementation exposes, so one flow per platform drives them all. {id} is a task id.

ids.sessionGuard.message: Shown instead of the app when a mock base URL was given without a session
ids.signIn.error: Why sign-in failed, or why the last session ended
ids.tasks.row.{id}.done: Present on a row whose task is done
ids.tasks.count: "N tasks", the total the server reported for the current filter
ids.tasks.filterLabel: The current filter: All, Open or Done
ids.tasks.loading: Shown while the first page loads
ids.tasks.empty: Shown when the current filter has no tasks
ids.tasks.error: Why the list could not load
ids.tasks.deleteAll: Delete All, shown in edit mode; asks for confirmation
ids.tasks.deleteAll.confirm: Confirms Delete All in the alert
ids.tasks.deleteAll.cancel: Cancels Delete All in the alert
ids.tasks.actionError: Why the last delete or change failed
ids.filter.close: Closes the filter sheet without changing the filter
ids.newTask.title: Title field
ids.newTask.error: Why the task could not be saved
ids.task.title: The task's title on its detail screen
ids.task.notes: The task's notes on its detail screen
ids.task.done: Done switch on the detail screen
ids.task.error: Why the task could not load or change
